content.text: BAWIPA teh pholen awh. BAWIPA min teh pholen awh.
BAWIPA e a sannaw ama teh pholen awh.
BAWIPA e min dawk thoseh,
maimae Cathut im thongma dawk thoseh,
thaw ka tawk e a sannaw pueng ama teh pholen awh.
BAWIPA teh ahawi, BAWIPA teh pholen awh.
Bawipa e min hah la sak awh. Hottelah sak e teh a kamcu.
Atangcalah BAWIPA ni Jakop hah ama hanelah thoseh,
Isarel hah amae hno lah o sak hanelah thoseh a rawi toe.
Hatdawkvah, Jehovah teh a len e hoi maimae Bawipa teh,
cathut pueng e lathueng lah ao tie hah ka panue.
BAWIPA teh kalvan hoi talai hai thoseh,
tuipui hoi adungnae koehai thoseh,
a ngai e patetlah a sak.
BAWIPA ni tâmainaw hah
talai apoutnae koehoi a luen sak teh,
kho hoi sumpa a palik sak teh,
kahlî hah a hnoim thung hoi a tâco sak.
Ama ni Izip ram vah tami hoi saring totouh
caminnaw hah a thei pouh.
Oe Izip ram ahni ni mitnoutnaw hoi
kângairu mitnoutnaw hah nangmouh koe,
Faro siangpahrang hoi a thaw katawknaw
pueng koe a thosak toe.
Bawipa ni miphun moikapap a moum teh,
athakaawme siangpahrangnaw hah a thei.
Hotnaw teh Amor siangpahrang Sihon,
Bashan siangpahrang Og, hoi kanaan uknaeramnaw doeh
Hathnukkhu, ahnimae talai hah a tami Isarelnaw râw lah a poe.
Oe BAWIPA, nange min teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Oe BAWIPA, na kamthang teh catounnaw totouh a cak.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA Cathut ni
a miphun hah lawk a ceng teh, a sannaw hah a pahrenlungma,
Jentelnaw e meikaphawknaw teh,
sui, ngun lah ao teh, kut hoi sak e lah ao.
Hotnaw teh pahni a tawn awh ei lawk dei thai awh hoeh.
Mit a tawn awh ei, hmawt thai awh hoeh.
Hnâ a tawn awh ei, thai awh hoeh.
Ahnimae kâko dawk kâha hai awm hoeh.
Hotnaw ka sak e hoi kayuemnaw pueng hai
hotnaw patetlah ao awh han.
Oe Isarelnaw, BAWIPA hah yawhawi poe awh.
Aron catounnaw BAWIPA hah yawhawi poe awh.
Oe Levih catounnaw BAWIPA hah pholen awh.
BAWIPA ka taket e naw, BAWIPA hah pholen awh.
Jerusalem vah kaawm e BAWIPA Cathut teh,
Zion hoi pholen awh.
Hallelujah.
